subject.title: Tool error messages surfaced to chat should include failure reason and retry confirmation

question: Should normal user-visible chat show redacted tool-failure reasons and matched recovery confirmations, and which channel/tool trust rules should gate that behavior?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the safe default depends on maintainer policy for redaction, channel trust, mutating side effects, and operator-facing recovery semantics.

options.title: Adopt redacted recovery-aware chat policy
options.body: Surface sanitized failure reasons and recovered notices only for allowed tools/channels and matched successful retries.

options.title: Keep details internal by default
options.body: Continue hiding ordinary raw reasons in normal chat and rely on agent summaries, diagnostics, or verbose/trusted modes for detail.

options.title: Split reason and recovery policy
options.body: Define a narrow redacted reason policy first, then track retry-success confirmation under broader native recovery work.

recommendation.title: Adopt redacted recovery-aware chat policy
recommendation.body: Surface sanitized failure reasons and recovered notices only for allowed tools/channels and matched successful retries.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent current-main routing signal for the payload and tool-handler surface, with steipete as the policy-history fallback.
